text: The text contains sarcasm in the first two sentences. The speaker claims to "love" when their phone dies during an important call and calls it the "best feature of modern technology." Since phone battery failure during critical moments is universally frustrating and undesirable, the positive language is used ironically to express strong annoyance or anger. This sarcasm flips the apparent positive sentiment of the words "love" and "best" into a strongly negative sentiment regarding the situation. The final sentence is a factual question and does not contain sarcasm.
